Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1 to be carried out on a weekly 
bases as indicated by W1 in the title block

The first draft initiated by eng. Ouf Mohamed Ali, tested by eng: Doaa Anis, revised MDEPC quality control engineer: Adel Abdel Qader Al- Nagar, 
accepted by eng. Mostafa El-Klmshy
general director, approved by eng Mahmoud Sakr head Sector of Talkha 
750 Power station.
This document certified by eng. Samir Abdel Gilel: MDEPC inspection and quality 
control general director & MPIS coordinator, approved by eng. Mohamed Nageb: 
MDEPC inspection &quality control head Sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued
The maintenance staff should be 
 trained, qualified, and carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding work area is required.
Wear the safety and healthy 
 equipment.
The unit must be on service.
Tools and Equipment
Complete tool set.
Digital voltmeter and clamp 
 ammeter.
New brushes.
Useful brush length.
Work to be Carried Out
Check the brush vibration.
Check the sparking brushes.
Check brush holders and slip rings.
Replace the brush by a new one if its height Falls to 20mm.
Record current and voltage value of generator as in MRDS and 
 compare the results with the standard value fig (1)
